verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm Cursor serves an llms.txt index at cursor.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, linking .md doc pages) and a markdown version of the Bugbot docs at cursor.com/docs/bugbot.md. An agent can therefore be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs for this product. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown-docs offering, confirmation that the llms.txt index explicitly covers Bugbot pages (the probe output is truncated), independent corroboration of agents using these docs effectively.
